messages:
nina-peopleops: @carlos-candidate quick thread to confirm logistics for your remote interview next Fri. You mentioned you're in BRT and need Brazilian Portuguese captions and a sign-language interpreter. Can you confirm preferred start time windows?

carlos-candidate: Hi Nina — I can do 09:30-12:30 BRT or 15:00-18:00 BRT. I need Brazilian Portuguese captions (if possible), a LIBRAS interpreter, and a note about 10 extra minutes per block for breaks.

henry-hiringmgr: 09:30 BRT works for me (my morning). We'll aim for a 50m loop: 30m tech, 20m hiring mgr. Can we shorten to 45m if schedule tight?

tess-eng: I can join 09:30. I prefer coding exercise on shared editor; if connection flaky we can switch to take-home.

omar-eng: I'm in UTC+1 but can do 09:30 BRT. Do we need a prebrief? 10m prebrief should be fine.

recruiter-bot: Candidate profile attached to invite (internal link). Suggested panel: Henry (HM), Tess (Eng), Omar (Eng), Nina (People Ops).

nina-peopleops: I'll arrange a LIBRAS interpreter through our vendor and request PT-BR captions. Carlos, are you comfortable with the interpreter joining the call? Also we can provide a local Brazil dial-in if needed.

carlos-candidate: Yes comfortable with interpreter joining. Local dial-in would be good. Also please add consent for transcript + interpreter notes to the invite.

calendar-bot: Created tentative invite: "Remote Interview  Carlos (SWE)" 2026-07-02 09:30 BRT  attendees: henry-hiringmgr, tess-eng, omar-eng, nina-peopleops, carlos-candidate. (Status: tentative)

nina-peopleops: I'll attach accommodation note: "LIBRAS interpreter will join; PT-BR captions requested; allow +10m per section if candidate requests." Also scheduling a 10m prebrief 09:20 BRT.

tess-eng: Please include fallback: if live interpreter fails, pause and reschedule interview segment, or offer async take-home.

omar-eng: Can we also offer a short 15-min orientation call the day before so Carlos can test dial-in, captions, and interpreter connection?

carlos-candidate: A 15-min test call day before at 18:00 BRT works. Thank you for arranging the interpreter and captions.

nina-peopleops: Noted. I'll send confirmation email with final invite + consent checkbox for transcript/interpreter notes. Also will add travel reimbursement info in case Carlos wants an on-site interview later (just for records).

henry-hiringmgr: Sounds good. Please confirm once interpreter vendor is booked.

nina-peopleops: Will confirm vendor booking here when complete and flip invite to confirmed. :white_check_mark:
